entries.name: Craft Suite
entries.summary: Portable Craft workflow prose for editing selected image, vector, slide or PDF workcopies and verifying Photo-to-Vector handoffs with explicit evidence boundaries. Drives the ArtCraft open tool family (github.com/storytold: PhotoCraft, VectorCraft, DeckCraft, PrintCraft and more). Original OpenRA work: no executable code, no application-internal recipes.

entries.name: Diagram Design
entries.summary: Branded presentation diagrams (architecture, flowchart, sequence, ER, timeline, Sankey and 40+ more types) as HTML/SVG/PNG, with draw.io, Mermaid and Excalidraw import. OpenRA-adapted carry of the upstream skill; the recorded differences are in PROVENANCE.md inside the skill.

entries.name: Human Writing
entries.summary: Write prose that reads as human: style control for fiction, forum posts and factual writing, with a check_prose.py revision pass. Carried verbatim from KKKKhazix/human-writing at the pinned commit; the carried file set only excludes VERSION, another runtime's agent config, and a generated distribution file.

entries.name: OfficeCLI Academic Paper
entries.summary: Academic-style .docx output: journal/conference/thesis chapters with APA, Chicago, IEEE or MLA citation style, numbered equations, cross-references, footnotes and bibliography. OpenRA-adapted carry of the iOfficeAI/AionCore skill: the install section is replaced by a prerequisite check (officecli must already be installed via OpenRA's approved CLI path; the skill only verifies officecli --version) and an Apache-2.0 §4(b) modification notice is added; everything else is upstream text.

entries.name: OfficeCLI Data Dashboard
entries.summary: Multi-element Excel dashboards from CSV or tabular input: Dashboard sheet on open, formula-driven KPI cards, charts, sparklines and conditional formatting. OpenRA-adapted carry of the iOfficeAI/AionCore skill: the install section is replaced by a prerequisite check (officecli must already be installed via OpenRA's approved CLI path; the skill only verifies officecli --version) and an Apache-2.0 §4(b) modification notice is added; everything else is upstream text.
